name: Thalassian Pass post
region: Thalassian Pass, southern border of Quel'Thalas facing Lordaeron

sensoryProfile.sight: Squat dark tower against stars over the peaks; gate lamps burning white-blue at the end of the yard; outer stones standing below in a grey line across the saddle; guardroom with white-blue ward-lamps in iron brackets; a stone alcove off the cell passage with the staff on two hooks beneath a slate plate carved in close lines
sensoryProfile.sound: Gate bar dragged back; voices ringing off yard walls; a cup set down on the guardroom table; ward-hum, rising through hooves as the road descends toward the outer stones
sensoryProfile.smell: Lamp oil and cold iron in the rack alcove; horses and stable
sensoryProfile.touch: Thick walls sweating where hearth warmth meets cold stone; night wind off the saddle with snow in it
sensoryProfile.atmosphere: Winter-built, watchful; more rangers on duty than usual for the hour

establishedFacts.fact: A Farstrider post commanded by Cyndia, 'with her full company'. Gate rangers recognise Sylvanas's colours and open at once.
Guardroom: ward-lamps light every corner with steady white-blue light; a table with an abandoned bowl of stew and a spoon standing in it; rangers lined along the far wall near their bows.
Rack alcove off the passage to the cells: slate dampening plate; staff across two hooks; satchel contents on the shelf below.
The cells are down a passage; the prisoner is in the second door from the end.
The outer stones stand in a line across the saddle of the pass.

Staff, left on the hooks beneath the plate, went 'dull' (crystal gone the colour of a bruise); when Cyndia hands it back the violet drains and the crystal's own pale colour returns, and a deep thrum runs up the haft. Cyndia returned the satchel with stockings folded darned-heels outward on top of the pebble.

A stable stands off the yard; the party mounts under the squat tower in the yard at night; the gate bar is dragged back by gate rangers; the road from the gate leads down switchbacks to the outer stones.
A relay system exists: the Pass keeps fresh horses; Neral will change horses 'at the Pass' on the way through if word must go north.

eventsHere.event: Cyndia's report, gear inspection, map examined, Jaina identified, interrogation opens.
Party leaves at night: Jaina's staff and satchel returned, horses issued, the gate bar dragged back.
